companyClaims.claim: The move-in cleaning checklist focuses on reachable surfaces, floors, visible trim, high-touch areas, kitchens, and bathrooms.
companyClaims.sourceQuote: We focus on the areas that matter most before you bring your belongings inside. Home Interior Dust reachable surfaces and fixtures Vacuum and mop floors Wipe baseboards and visible trim Clean doors, handles and high-touch areas Kitchen & Bathrooms Clean counters, sinks and appliance exteriors Clean cabinet fronts and reachable shelves Sanitize showers, tubs, toilets and vanities Remove visible dust and move-in residue

companyClaims.claim: The deep cleaning service is described as detailed attention to buildup, corners, baseboards, kitchen and bathroom areas, and other easy-to-miss spaces.
companyClaims.sourceQuote: Deep cleaning goes beyond the weekly basics, focusing on buildup, corners, baseboards and the spaces that are easy to miss. Kitchen Detail Grease, counters, sinks, appliance exteriors and visible buildup. Bathroom Detail Tubs, showers, toilets, vanities, mirrors and high-touch areas.
